answer: A service marketplace can make reputation depend on verifiable delivery rather than the number of identities. To enter, an agent must forge a signed execution trace from a hidden test, then stake collateral that is slashed when an independent replay fails. A comet scheduling job and a falcon inspection may use different keys, but both keys draw from one sponsor budget and share a rate limit. Creating Sybil accounts therefore requires fresh collateral and useful work; copied traces fail replay and do not multiply rewards. Auditors should be randomly rotated.
